name: MistScale
shortDescription: Memory for game NPCs. Homepage checked; a dedicated /docs URL returned 404 once.
longDescription: MistScale is aimed at memory for game NPCs. Homepage copy we had already seen talks about trying it without a card; reconfirm that on the live page. mistscale.com/docs returned 404 in one check, and we did not find a separate pricing URL. We did not create an account.
pricingNotes: Dedicated pricing URL not found; pricing may be embedded on homepage.

Deep public docs — the docs path 404’d in this check
